title: One line of feed/rates/mra-rates-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl
description: One value of one rate series on day snapshot_date. The file is a full snapshot: every series its source confirmed on that day has one valid line, also when the value did not change, plus the rejected readings of the day as a trace. A series that could not be read on that day has no line; an old value is never copied forward. Every number is read from the page of its publisher. MERGE on (snapshot_date, series_key, status). Every field is present on every line.

schema_version.description: Version of the file layout; 1 is the layout described here. It rises only when a field changes type or meaning or is dropped.

snapshot_date.description: Day D of the snapshot in Vietnam time, the same date as in the file name.

confirmed_at.description: Last time on snapshot_date the source page was read and showed this value.

changed.description: true when (value, as_of) differs from the latest valid line of the series before snapshot_date, or when the series is new. false when nothing changed, and always false on a rejected line.

prev_value.description: Latest valid value of the series before snapshot_date; equals value when changed is false. null for a series seen for the first time.

prev_as_of.description: as_of of prev_value. null when prev_value is null.

obs_id.description: Id of the observation: 12 hex characters of a hash of (series_key, as_of, value). One observation is one value of one series as published.

source_id.description: Id of the page the value was read from: sbv_central_rate, vcb_fx, or deposit- followed by the bank code.

series_key.description: Stable id of the time series, e.g. usd_vnd_central, vcb_fx/USD/transfer, deposit/VCB/12/online. The key to follow one series across days.

kind.description: What the series measures. central_rate = the central USD/VND rate announced by the State Bank of Vietnam; fx_quote = an exchange rate quoted by a bank; deposit_rate = a deposit interest rate posted by a bank.

bank_code.description: Short code of the bank, e.g. VCB, ACB. null for the State Bank of Vietnam.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. For central_rate and fx_quote, the foreign currency priced in VND; for deposit_rate, the currency of the deposit.

side.description: For fx_quote, which price of the bank. buy = the bank buys cash; transfer = the bank buys by transfer; sell = the bank sells. null for the other kinds.

term_months.description: For deposit_rate, the term in months; 0 is a demand deposit, 0.25 is one week. null for the other kinds.

channel.description: For deposit_rate, where the deposit is made. counter = at a branch; online = in the app or on the website. null for the other kinds.

value.description: The number, expressed in unit. null only on a rejected line whose number could not be read.

unit.description: Unit of value. VND = Vietnamese dong for one unit of currency; pct_per_year = percent per year.

as_of.description: Date the value applies from, as the source states it.

as_of_inferred.description: true when the source page states no date and as_of is the day the collector first read the value.

doc_no.description: Number of the official document behind the value, e.g. 414/TB-NHNN. null when there is none.

issued.description: Date the official document was issued. null when there is none.

status.description: Result of the checks on the reading. valid = passed the format and range checks; rejected = read from the page but failed a check, kept as a trace and not to be used as data.

reject_reason.description: Why a rejected line failed its check. null on a valid line.

source_url.description: URL of the page the value was read from.

snapshot_ref.description: Path of the stored copy of the source page in the private archive. A reference for audit only; the copy is not in this repository.

first_seen.description: When the collector first read this value for the series.
